title: OmniACBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Context-Grounded Acoustic Control in Omni-Modal Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.23938v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Most testbeds for omni-modal models assess multimodal understanding via textual outputs, leaving it unclear whether these models can properly speak their answers. To study this, we introduce OmniACBench, a benchmark for evaluating context-grounded acoustic control in omni-modal models. Given a spoken instruction, a text script, and an image, a model must read the script aloud with an appropriate tone and manner. OmniACBench comprises 3,559 verified instances covering six acoustic features: speech rate, phonation, pronunciation, emotion, global accent, and timbre. Extensive experiments on eight models reveal their limitations in the proposed setting, despite their strong performance on prior textual-output evaluations. Our analyses show that the main bottleneck lies not in processing individual modalities, but in integrating multimodal context for faithful speech generation. translated_title: OmniACBench：一个用于评估全模态模型中基于上下文的声学控制能力的基准
translated_abstract: 大多数针对全模态模型的测试平台都通过文本输出来评估多模态理解能力，这使得这些模型能否正确地“说出”答案尚不清楚。为了研究这一问题，我们提出了OmniACBench，一个用于评估全模态模型中基于上下文的声学控制能力的基准。给定一个语音指令、一段文本脚本和一张图像，模型必须以恰当的语气和方式朗读该脚本。OmniACBench包含3,559个经过验证的实例，涵盖六种声学特征：语速、发声方式、发音、情感、整体口音和音色。对八个模型的大量实验表明，尽管它们在以往基于文本输出的评测中表现强劲，但在所提出的设置中仍存在明显局限。我们的分析表明，主要瓶颈不在于处理单个模态，而在于整合多模态上下文以实现忠实的语音生成。此外，我们还识别出三种常见的失败模式。
tldr: 提出了OmniACBench基准，通过要求模型根据语音指令、文本脚本和图像，以涵盖语速、发声、发音、情感、口音和音色六种声学特征的恰当语气朗读文本，评估全模态模型的声学控制能力，并揭示其主要瓶颈在于多模态上下文的整合而非单模态处理。
en_tdlr: OmniACBench is a benchmark of 3,559 verified instances for evaluating context-grounded acoustic control in omni-modal models, revealing that their main bottleneck lies in integrating multimodal context for faithful speech generation rather than processing individual modalities.
